design.surface: existing optional shared geometry/soft-ground tracks; no second trail texture or per-frame vertex upload; cut applies only after dense terrain is installed; receive-only shadows
design.limits: smaller/sparser than reference; original painted atlas rather than smoothed center; no additional mass-conserving berm simulation; distance height fade is not submission LOD

engine_fix.root_cause: Forward+ changed shader version and mutable state before waiting for pending pipeline workers. Dirty-version lookup in a pending worker could free obsolete RD shader RIDs from outside the render thread. Move clear_pipelines before mutation; compiler mutex was already scoped correctly.
